title: Today’s task: 95 days to go — mobilize one voter
summary: Election day is 95 days away — 16 January 2027 at 9:00am. Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan), NDC candidate for Yewa North/Imeko-Afon, asks supporters to talk to one person who needs a PVC and share the reminder so the constituency is ready.

title: BBC Africa: Peter Obi on 2023 claims, NDC platform and fuel subsidy
summary: NDC presidential candidate Peter Obi speaks to BBC Africa about the 2023 election, his current NDC platform, and his position on restoring fuel subsidy without the corruption that plagued the old system. Watch and share.

title: Today’s task: share the accountable representation agenda
summary: Oluwadara Kehinde (Akan), NDC candidate for Yewa North/Imeko-Afon, asks supporters to share his commitment to transparent, year-round representation — oversight, feedback, and accessibility to every ward.

title: NDC uploads Peter Obi’s name to INEC portal amid appeal
summary: NDC National Leader Seriake Dickson says the party has uploaded Peter Obi’s name to the INEC candidate portal and filed an appeal against a court ruling, assuring supporters the process continues.
